Ruling: Reuse existing owned AVC/AAC dash_variants bytes instead of regenerating — avoids CPU load and preserves published hashes — eight seconds does not cover the full 30-second profile; real ABR baseline needs longer owned media later.
Ruling: Tool-only work runs short Python tests, no playback, device use or full-suite/native builds — avoid perturbing the concurrent long-play verification — tool success cannot establish CAP-ABR/CAP-LIVE.
Pre-flight: Task 1 produces versioned profiles and request traces for Task 2/4; no public player API changes. P08 numerical baseline/targets remain prerequisites for quantitative playback acceptance. PD-02/03 unaffected.
Task 1A: in progress. TDD first, virtual clock for exact byte/time assertions and short loopback HTTP tests for actual bytes and failures. RTT is application response latency, not physical packet RTT. No end-to-end latency inferred.
